description: This line plot illustrates the relative change in performance metrics across different layers of a model, comparing various token-precision configurations against a baseline. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," is divided into five categorical intervals: "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32", representing distinct segments of the model's architecture. The y-axis, labeled "Relative Change", is scaled linearly from -25% to 5%, with tick marks at every 5% interval. Four distinct lines represent different configurations: a yellow line with circle markers for "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit", a red line with square markers for "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit", a cyan line with circle markers for "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit", and a dark blue line with square markers for "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit". A dashed gray line represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit", which remains nearly flat near 0%. The yellow line starts near 0% and ends near 0%, showing minimal fluctuation. The red line begins near 0%, dips to approximately -5% at Layer13-20, and then rises slightly. The cyan line starts near 0%, dips sharply to approximately -15% at Layer13-20, and then rises to approximately -5% at Layer29-32. The dark blue line begins near -5%, drops to approximately -25% at Layer13-20, and then rises to approximately -5% at Layer29-32.
